items.title: What's on This Page
items.why:
Erica's Goku in the look of her iRob app. Every picture is her real Goku screen; only the look changes. Nothing is built yet, and nothing in iRob was changed.

The pictures in the Weezy look are iRob's own painted icons and Weezy poses, so no new drawings are needed.

items.title: How Far Should It Go?
items.why: Today Erica has the Dragon Ball look.

options.label: The Weezy look
options.desc: iRob's gold-on-charcoal colors and fonts, iRob's painted icons, Weezy as her picture, and gentle words in place of the Dragon Ball ones.

options.label: Colors and fonts only
options.desc: The Dragon Ball words, icons and Scouter stay.

items.title: The Words
items.why: Scouter → Check-in · Power level → Energy · Saga → Journey · Arc → Chapter · Boss → Goal · Senzu bean → cozy day · Dragon Balls → gold hearts · Shenron → Weezy · Dragon Ball master → Weezy's favorite · Gravity chamber → Workout.

items.title: Weezy's Pictures Would Be Public
items.why: Goku's code is public on GitHub, and iRob's is private. The Weezy look puts about 30 of iRob's painted pictures in Goku: Weezy poses and icons like the cat basket, fork and knife, and gold heart. Anyone who looks at Goku's code could see them. Nothing else from iRob goes in: no chat, music, notes or anything about Erica.

options.label: Keep them private
options.desc: Then only the colors and fonts can come over.

items.title: Light Mode
items.why: iRob has a light version too. Goku follows the phone's light or dark setting.

items.title: Fonts
items.why: iRob's fonts: Cinzel for headings and buttons, Lora for text. They're stored in Goku, so they work offline. Numbers in Lora have the old-style shape, as in iRob (the 0 looks like a small o).

options.label: Cinzel headings only
options.desc: Regular app font for text and numbers.

items.title: One Missing Icon
items.why: iRob's icon set has no scale for the Weight row, so the mock-up uses a gold coin.

options.label: Use the coin for now
options.desc: I can add a scale to a future ChatGPT brief.

options.label: Ask ChatGPT for a scale first

items.title: Who Can Pick It
items.why: It's Erica's look. Every look shows in the Look menu.

items.title: Build It?
items.why: After your picks I build it as 2.34.0, run every check, and publish. Erica's phone switches the next time she opens Goku.

options.label: Build and publish when checks pass
